gap:logistic_hyperparameter_tuning.statement: Need to determine optimal L2 regularization strength and compression strategy for logistic regression using exact fitting conventions with 5-fold CV and custom gradient descent.

hyp:interaction_features_improve.statement: Adding interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) may improve logistic regression performance measured by paired t-test across folds.

exp:logistic_regression_cv.statement: Conducted 5-fold cross-validation with contiguous fold splitting on logistic regression with L2 regularization. Tested lambda values [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0] using full-batch gradient descent (200 iterations, lr=0.1, logits clipped [-30, 30]).

claim:lambda_01_optimal.statement: L2 regularization strength of 0.1 produces the lowest 5-fold cross-validated Brier score (0.207077) among tested lambda values, with improvement of 0.00890 over baseline (lambda=0).

claim:interactions_significant.statement: Adding interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improves logistic regression performance. Paired t-test across 5 folds yields t=3.912 > 2.0 (p=0.0174), indicating interaction features reduce Brier score by mean 0.0257.

claim:compression_config.statement: Among compression configurations tested (sparsity ∈ {20,40,60}%, bits ∈ {4,8}), sparsity=20% with 4-bit quantization achieves highest retention (0.9992) of dense model Brier performance on training data.

receipt:final_answers.statement: All three task components completed successfully: (1) best_lambda=0.1, improvement_over_baseline=0.00890, (2) paired_t_stat=3.912, interaction_helps=True, (3) best_config="sparsity20_bits4". Results written to answers.json.
